record.field: Customer companies ranked by the number of active contacts, with the date the last one was added.

SELECT parent.id, parent.name AS company, COUNT(child.id) AS contacts, MAX(child.create_date) AS last_added FROM res_partner parent JOIN res_partner child ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE parent.is_company AND child.active AND (parent.company_id IS NULL OR parent.company_id = ANY(:company_ids)) GROUP BY parent.id, parent.name HAVING COUNT(child.id) >= :min_contacts ORDER BY contacts DESC, company
Draft: data quality check before a mailing.
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.parent_id, p.phone FROM res_partner p WHERE p.active AND p.type = 'contact' AND COALESCE(p.email, '') = '' ORDER BY p.name
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.email, p.create_date FROM res_partner p WHERE p.create_date >= :since ORDER BY p.create_date DESC
Contacts created in a period, optionally limited to some countries, companies or one address type.

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.type, COALESCE(c.name ->> :lang, c.name ->> 'en_US') AS country, p.is_company, p.create_date FROM res_partner p LEFT JOIN res_country c ON c.id = p.country_id WHERE p.create_date >= :date_from AND p.create_date < :date_to + 1 AND (cardinality(:countries::int[]) = 0 OR p.country_id = ANY(:countries)) AND (NOT :companies_only OR p.is_company) AND (COALESCE(:address_type, '') = '' OR p.type = :address_type) ORDER BY p.create_date DESC
